name: roop-eval-v1
description: Machine-checkable coding tasks for local model success-rate tables

tasks.title: Implement mean and median
tasks.description: Create src/math_utils.py with mean() and median(). Empty list raises ValueError. Do not mutate input. Create tests/test_math_utils.py with unittest covering mean([1,2,3])==2, median([1,2,3])==2, median([1,2,3,4])==2.5, empty list ValueError.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: mean/median behave as described; unittest passes

tasks.title: Implement clamp utility
tasks.description: Create src/clamp.py with clamp(value, low, high) returning value limited to [low, high]. If low > high raise ValueError. Add tests/test_clamp.py unittest.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: clamp(5,0,10)==5, clamp(-1,0,10)==0, clamp(99,0,10)==10, low>high ValueError

tasks.title: Implement slugify
tasks.description: Create src/slugify.py with slugify(text) that lowercases, replaces spaces with '-', strips non-alnum except '-', collapses repeats. Add tests/test_slugify.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: slugify('Hello World')=='hello-world'; empty -> ''; unittest passes

tasks.title: Implement Stack class
tasks.description: Create src/stack.py with Stack having push, pop, peek, is_empty, size. pop/peek on empty raise IndexError. Add tests/test_stack.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: stack ops work; empty pop/peek IndexError; unittest passes

tasks.title: Parse key=value lines
tasks.description: Create src/kv.py with parse_kv(text) returning dict from lines 'key=value', ignore blank/# comments, last duplicate wins. Add tests/test_kv.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: parse_kv handles comments/blanks/duplicates; unittest passes

tasks.title: Implement is_palindrome
tasks.description: Create src/palindrome.py with is_palindrome(text) ignoring case and non-alphanumeric chars. Add tests/test_palindrome.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: is_palindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama') is True; empty True; unittest passes

tasks.title: Chunk a list
tasks.description: Create src/chunk.py with chunk_list(items, size) yielding/returning consecutive chunks. size < 1 raises ValueError. Add tests/test_chunk.py.

tasks.title: Flatten one level
tasks.description: Create src/flatten.py with flatten_once(seq) flattening one nesting level only. Add tests/test_flatten.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: flatten_once([1,[2,3],[4]])==[1,2,3,4]; nested deeper stays nested one level

tasks.title: Top-N counter
tasks.description: Create src/counter_top.py with top_n(items, n) returning most common items as list of (item, count) sorted by count desc then item. n<1 raises ValueError. Add tests/test_counter_top.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: top_n(['a','b','a'],2) works; unittest passes

tasks.title: Safe division
tasks.description: Create src/safe_div.py with safe_div(a,b, default=None) returning a/b or default when b==0. Add tests/test_safe_div.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: safe_div(10,2)==5; safe_div(1,0,0)==0; unittest passes

tasks.title: Deep merge dicts
tasks.description: Create src/merge.py with deep_merge(a,b) recursively merging dicts; b wins on conflicts; do not mutate inputs. Add tests/test_merge.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: nested merge works; inputs unchanged; unittest passes

tasks.title: Mini LRU cache
tasks.description: Create src/lru.py with LRUCache(capacity) supporting get/put; capacity < 1 raises ValueError; eviction is least-recently-used. Add tests/test_lru.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: capacity eviction works; get updates recency; unittest passes

tasks.title: Normalize posix paths
tasks.description: Create src/pathnorm.py with normalize_path(path) resolving . and .. for posix-like paths without OS calls. Add tests/test_pathnorm.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: normalize_path('a/./b/../c')=='a/c'; absolute and relative cases covered

tasks.title: Retry helper
tasks.description: Create src/retry.py with retry(fn, retries, exceptions=(Exception,)) calling fn until success or retries exhausted then re-raise. retries < 0 raises ValueError. Add tests/test_retry.py using a callable that fails then succeeds.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: retries then succeeds; exhausted re-raises; unittest passes

tasks.title: Parse INI-like sections
tasks.description: Create src/ini_mini.py with parse_sections(text) -> dict[str, dict[str,str]] for [section] and key=value lines. Add tests/test_ini_mini.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: multiple sections parse; comments ignored; unittest passes

tasks.title: Bounded queue
tasks.description: Create src/bqueue.py with BoundedQueue(maxsize) push/pop/peek/size/is_full. push when full raises OverflowError; pop empty IndexError. Add tests/test_bqueue.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: FIFO + bounds enforced; unittest passes

tasks.title: Shoelace polygon area
tasks.description: Create src/geometry.py with polygon_area(points) using shoelace formula; need >=3 points else ValueError. Add tests/test_geometry.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: unit square area 1; <3 points ValueError; unittest passes

tasks.title: JSON config roundtrip
tasks.description: Create src/config_io.py with save_config(path, data) and load_config(path) using json; create parent dirs; invalid json raises ValueError. Add tests/test_config_io.py using tempfile.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: roundtrip dict; bad json ValueError; unittest passes

tasks.title: Merge intervals
tasks.description: Create src/intervals.py with merge_intervals(intervals) merging overlapping [start,end] lists. Add tests/test_intervals.py.

tasks.title: Topological sort
tasks.description: Create src/topo.py with topo_sort(nodes, edges) returning a valid topological order; cycle raises ValueError. edges are (u,v) meaning u before v. Add tests/test_topo.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: valid order for DAG; cycle ValueError; unittest passes
